rules: Current-vintage snapshots only; releaseDate is unknown, so these values are not eligible for leakage-free historical as-of backtests.
Unknown, suppressed or inapplicable SIDRA values remain null. SIDRA dash represents exact zero.
PNAD observations are overlapping rolling quarters, indexed by the ending month; never treat them as independent single-month observations.
PNAD real measures are already deflated by IBGE and must not be deflated again.
Census 2022 household per-capita income is nominal monthly resident income, not GDP per capita, household-head income, or current 2026 income.
PAM is an annual local agricultural production proxy; it is not household income or directly measured vehicle demand.
PAM area can count successive crops; it is crop area, not unique physical land area.
Senatran fleet is a registered-vehicle stock, not new registrations or new vehicle sales.
Population, GDP, census and PAM reference years differ; report each year and retain boundary gaps.
